title: Gem
text:
Gems are a type of item that either grants a skill (skill gem) or modifies a skill (support gem) when placed into a gem socket.
There are currently 245 different skill gems, 16 different meta skill gems and 536 support gems in the game, for a total of 797. 


== Skill gems ==

Skill gems can be socketed in the skill panel to gain an active skill which can be assigned on the player's keybinds. Up to 9 skill gems can be bound simultaneously by default. The number of skill gems you can have socketed at one time can be increased with an Unset RingUnset RingRequires Level 44Grants 1 additional Skill Slot or the Instill-exclusive passive, Augmented Flesh.
Characters need to meet the skill gem's level and attribute requirements to be able to use it. Level and attribute requirements increase as a skill gem is leveled up.
When creating a skill gem using an Uncut Skill GemUncut Skill GemCreates a Skill Gem or Level an existing gem to level #Right Click to engrave a Skill Gem., it will be engraved at a gem level matching that of the uncut gem. Skill gems can be levelled up further using an Uncut Skill GemUncut Skill GemCreates a Skill Gem or Level an existing gem to level #Right Click to engrave a Skill Gem. up to level 20. A Gemcutter's PrismGemcutter's PrismStack Size: 20Improves the quality of a Skill GemRight click this item then left click a skill gem to apply it. adds 5% quality to a skill gem, up to 20%.


=== Corruption ===
Corrupting a skill gem can cause it to gain or lose a skill level, gem socket, or quality. 

Corruption effects that add or subtract a gem level are innate to the skill gem and works independently from the gem's actual level.
A skill gem can have up to 23% base quality via corruption.
Corruption cannot cause a skill gem to have more than 5 sockets.
Corrupted gems can be leveled using an Uncut Skill Gem.
When double corrupting a skill gem with Crystallised CorruptionCrystallised CorruptionStack Size: 10Modifies a Corrupted Skill Gem unpredictably or destroys itRight click this item then left click on a corrupted gem to apply it., it cannot roll the same effect as the corruption effect it already had (Ex. you cannot get +1 to gem level on a corrupted gem that already has a +1 to gem level corruption).


=== Kalguuran skill ===
Kalguuran skills are special types of skill gems that can be acquired from Verisium Remnants. Kalguuran skills have no attribute requirements and are not aligned to any attribute. All Kalguuran skills use Runic Ward, either as their skill cost or interacting with Runic Ward in some way. Kalguuran skill gems can have their levels upgraded using a Thaumaturgic Flux.


== Spirit gems ==

Spirit gems, or persistent buff skill gems, are special skill gems which can only be created using an Uncut Spirit GemUncut Spirit GemCreates a Persistent Buff Skill Gem or Level an existing gem to Level #Right Click to engrave a Persistent Buff Skill Gem.. They can be socketed to gain access to skills that grant persistent buffs, trigger other skills, or to summon permanent minions. These gems have require the reservation of spirit in order to gain their effect.
Spirit gems can be supported by support gems, but this will often increase the reservation based on the support gem's cost multiplier. Other support gems may incur a flat spirit reservation instead which does not scale.
Similar to skill gems, characters need to meet the spirit gem's level and attribute requirements and sometimes weapon requirements to be able to use them.
Skills granted by spirit gems can be activated in the skill panel by right-clicking the desired spirit gem. They may also have a skill component which can be used directly.
Spirit gems can be corrupted and uses the same results as skill gems.


== Support gems ==

Support gems can be socketed into individual skills; these modify the effects of the supported skill. Each gem is limited to two support slots at start, with up to three additional supports available via the use of Jeweller's Orbs. Skills granted by items and Ascendancy skills can also have sockets; their number of sockets is based on the item's item level or your character level, respectively.
You cannot have multiple support gems that share the same category socketed to the same skill. Additionally, only one copy per rank of support gems that add a spirit reservation is allowed across all your skills; for example, you cannot socket more than one copy of Herbalism IHerbalism ISupport, Buff, PersistentCategory: HerbalismTier: 2Additional Reservation: 15 SpiritSupport Requirements: +5 StrSupports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.30% Increased Recovery from Life Flasks while a Supported Skill is activePlace into a Skill's Support Gem socket in the Skills Panel to apply its effects to that Skill. You cannot have multiple Support Gems of the same Category socketed within one Skill., but you can socket Herbalism IIHerbalism IISupport, Buff, PersistentCategory: HerbalismTier: 4Additional Reservation: 30 SpiritSupport Requirements: +5 StrSupports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.50% Increased Recovery from Life Flasks while a Supported Skill is activePlace into a Skill's Support Gem socket in the Skills Panel to apply its effects to that Skill. You cannot have multiple Support Gems of the same Category socketed within one Skill. in another skill.
The total number of support gems of each color are limited by the corresponding stat totals of the character, with 5 points of the stat allowing one support of that color.

Strength - Red
Dexterity - Green
Intelligence - Blue
For example, a character with 20 Strength, 40 Dexterity and 30 Intelligence would be able to use a total of 4 red, 8 green and 6 blue support gems.
Support gems cannot be corrupted or leveled.
Connected: Support gems count as connected as long as they not disabled and support the skill they are socketed into. They count as connected if they support a meta skill or any skills socketed in that meta skill. This feature is only used for certain mechanics such as Gemling Legionnaire's Integrated Efficiency.


=== Lineage support gems ===

Lineage support gems are special types of support gems. These cannot be crafted using Uncut Support Gems and can only be found as drops from the core drop pool or specific bosses.
Only one copy of each Lineage support gem can be socketed across all your skills. === Kalguuran support ===
Kalguuran supports are special types of support gems that can be acquired from Remnant encounters. They do not require attribute points to socket and are not aligned to any attribute. Kalguuran supports have effects that scale or interact with Runic Ward.
